fields.name: Null sentinel
fields.definition: A non-nullable .NET value that ArgentSea treats as database null when writing or reading a property that is not `Nullable<>`. `Guid.Empty`, `double.NaN` and `float.NaN` round-trip to database null. A property declared nullable stores these values literally instead. Null strings and arrays are database null, while empty strings are stored as zero-length strings. Nullable value types and nullable enums map null to database null directly.
